skill_hold.note: Rest 90-120 s. Build 3x10 s to 3x30 s (hardest holds: 3x20 s), then next variation.

main_strength.note: 3x5 to 3x8, then next variation. Easier variations may override to sets [4,4] reps [6,10].

core.note: reps applies to rep modes, seconds to time modes.

conditioning.note: Time-based, as on the whiteboards. Rep-mode conditioning exercises must override reps.

mobility.note: reps applies to rep modes, seconds to time modes.

stretch.note: Per-area total is capped at 4 min per session and 10 min per week (Ingram 2024).
